title: Persistent state
description: Atom: read The Tower tool_export (Rend/BlueStacks cache) into variables and append a CSV row. No clicks, no OCR.
notes: CSV: runs/stat_collect.csv. Source: %APPDATA%/rendapp/emulator-imports/toolExport_unknown.json (enable in Tower: Settings → tap Player ID ×5). cash = CashEarnedThisRound; diamonds ≡ gems.

actions.description: Load wave, wallets, tier, and round flags from tool_export.json.

actions.message: persistent state wave={wave_number} tier={tier} coins={coins} gems={gems} cells={cells} cash={cash} round={round_active} age={tool_export_age_s}s
actions.description: Echo the snapshot to the Automations console.
Append datetime, run, wave, and export fields to runs/stat_collect.csv.
